decision.explanation: The original source D1S3 explicitly states, 'He was one of the sons of the Frankish king Clotaire I and Queen Aregund.' This directly identifies Clotaire I as the father of Chilperic I. Other candidates like Lothair I, Guntram, Gondioc, and Childeric II refer to different individuals named Chilperic in other contexts (e.g., Chilperic II of Burgundy or Chilperic II of Neustria), not Chilperic I. Therefore, only Clotaire I is valid for the question as posed.
